scope: NAVE read-only research; external sources are not merged into canonical training data

evidence_tiers.B: published observational datasets with reproducible artifacts

sources.name: NAVE Dune Pump.fun panel
sources.provenance: Dune decoded Pump.fun events and dex_solana.trades; local Parquet materialization
sources.outcome_definition: first-hour mark proxies and targeted migrated continuation; no complete Runner label
sources.license: NAVE-local artifacts; source terms governed by Dune
limitations: missing depth, failed exits, priority/Jito, funding and BOOST attribution
sources.temporal_leakage_risk: controlled for local derived features; complete provider-availability latency remains to be measured
sources.survivorship_or_selection_risk: targeted continuation is migration-selected; deterministic launch sample is outcome-independent

sources.name: PumpFun Launch-to-Graduation Corpus
sources.owner: Slinky21 / citation identifies Slink Dev (slink21taken); no independent personal identity inferred
sources.provenance: websocket/on-chain RPC polling plus third-party concentration/holder API
sources.outcome_definition: graduation and post-graduation labels supplied by corpus; see KNOWN_ISSUES.md
sources.license: CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED: dataset card says MIT while README says CC-BY-4.0
sources.temporal_leakage_risk: high unless KNOWN_ISSUES handling and forward splits are applied
sources.survivorship_or_selection_risk: fixed complete launch window but external API and observer outages can affect coverage
sources.independently_verifiable: partly; source data are public but transformed corpus is not re-derived here
sources.nave_reproduce_feature: many launch/trade features; not canonical ground truth

sources.name: RED-PUMP-2026-v1
sources.owner: Arati Uday Kamat; public profile https://github.com/aartikamat
sources.provenance: single top-50 REST polling observer; current v1.4 corrigendum retained
sources.outcome_definition: graduation as observed within an effective <=6-minute visibility regime; true 24h graduation unknown
limitations: social effects are bounds, not clean causal effects
sources.temporal_leakage_risk: social and market metadata must be time-stamped at observation
sources.survivorship_or_selection_risk: strong observer-window selection; late graduations are underobserved
sources.nave_reproduce_feature: launch metadata and on-chain initial state; not the published graduation rate

sources.name: RED-COHORT-2026-v1
sources.provenance: read-only Solana observer; 8.4 MiB archive acquired locally
sources.outcome_definition: persistent first-buyer co-occurrence cohorts; not economic-actor identity
sources.license: dataset CC-BY-4.0; detector script MIT; patent notice requires future commercial legal review
limitations: released intra file contains co-fire groups, not full buyer-event input
co-occurrence is not proof of common control
sources.temporal_leakage_risk: activity and launch covariates must be measured before treatment/outcome
sources.survivorship_or_selection_risk: cohort detector selects repeated early co-occurrence
sources.independently_verifiable: catalogue structure verified; exact detector reproduction blocked by input incompleteness
sources.nave_reproduce_feature: yes for independent graph construction from NAVE events

sources.name: Post-Rejection Follow-up Sampling
sources.provenance: published methodology and MIT reference implementation
sources.outcome_definition: forward checkpoint observations after accepted/rejected decision
sources.license: MIT code; companion data terms separately governed
limitations: follow-up density, not mint-level coverage, binds classification quality
sources.temporal_leakage_risk: explicitly addressed by decision-time follow-up record
sources.survivorship_or_selection_risk: rejected population must be retained, not reconstructed from accepted trades

sources.name: RED-2400 and replication toolkit
sources.provenance: public Solana DEX filter-stack rejection log and linked follow-up observations
limitations: must preserve graveyard and unclassifiable states
sources.temporal_leakage_risk: rejection timestamp and reference price must be frozen before follow-up

sources.name: Trenches pump.fun Forward Capture 2026-08
sources.owner: Tr4m0ryp; citation identifies Ouallaf in release metadata
sources.provenance: Solana RPC plus vendor screen capture; per-field tau derivability timestamps
sources.outcome_definition: chain-derived path completion and terminal labels; forward split with embargo
limitations: vendor/reach fields not always derivable at first sighting
sources.temporal_leakage_risk: explicitly measurable from tau stamps; progress proxies excluded from features
sources.survivorship_or_selection_risk: instrument and gap-dependent; n_obs correlates with label quality
sources.independently_verifiable: metadata and manifests reviewed; Parquet not downloaded

sources.name: MELT: A Behavioral Trace Dataset
sources.owner: Sihao Hu, Selim Furkan Tekin, Yichang Xu, Ling Liu; git-disl
sources.coverage: 41,470 launches; 200M+ parsed transactions; period described by release artifacts
sources.provenance: parsed transaction and bundle traces; pre-generated feature artifacts advertised
sources.outcome_definition: high-risk launch labels and 122 behavioral features
sources.license: CC-BY-NC-4.0; patent/trademark rights not granted by license
sources.temporal_leakage_risk: bundle and post-launch features require strict cutoff audit
sources.survivorship_or_selection_risk: risk labels and model selection are source-specific
sources.independently_verifiable: code and paper reviewed; no large data downloaded
sources.nave_reproduce_feature: generic ideas only; no MELT code/data copied

sources.name: PumpApi historical replay / replayer-rust
sources.coverage: public archive advertised from 2026-04-18 onward; one-hour archive reachable by HEAD
sources.provenance: public hourly JSONL.zst replay archive; streaming Rust parser
sources.outcome_definition: typed create/buy/sell/migrate/add/remove tapes; no NAVE labels supplied
sources.license: repository license not confirmed; no code copied
limitations: archive response did not expose Content-Length
sources.temporal_leakage_risk: localTimestamp is replay metadata, not event availability
sources.survivorship_or_selection_risk: archive coverage and venue birth rules require validation
sources.nave_reproduce_feature: likely for typed events, priorityFee, postBalances and reserves pending audit

sources.name: $GRADUATE graduate-oracle
sources.coverage: public documentation and snapshots; current model state described as of 2026-05-07
sources.provenance: live observer and historical curve index documented by repository
sources.outcome_definition: graduation probability and auxiliary buyer-quality fields; graduation is not Runner quality
sources.license: repository license not confirmed; no API/account used
sources.temporal_leakage_risk: public accuracy snapshots and forward predictions must remain separate
sources.survivorship_or_selection_risk: historical index and hidden feed rules may differ from NAVE universe
sources.nave_reproduce_feature: baseline comparison later; not a NAVE input
